settings.heading: Build your discovery set
settings.text: Choose your minis and wear each one for a few days before you commit to a full bottle.

settings.heading: How long does each scent last?
settings.row_content: Our eaux de parfum last six to eight hours on skin and longer on fabric. Attars and extraits last a full day. Each product page shows its intensity.

settings.heading: How do I choose a scent online?
settings.row_content: Take the scent quiz for three personal matches, or order a discovery set and wear each mini for a few days before choosing a full bottle.

settings.heading: Do you offer samples?
settings.row_content: Every order includes a free sample vial. You can also build a discovery set of minis from the collection.

settings.heading: Where should I apply perfume?
settings.row_content: Spray on warm pulse points: wrists, neck and behind the ears. Don't rub; let it settle on its own.

settings.heading: How should I store my perfume?
settings.row_content: Keep bottles away from heat, sunlight and humidity. A cool drawer keeps a scent true for years.

settings.heading: What is your returns policy?
settings.row_content: Unopened bottles can be returned within 30 days. Share your full policy here.
